exposure: Early (<20 weeks) gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) screening
cohort: Pregnant women with indications for early GDM screening: GDM or macrosomia in a prior pregnancy or obesity
finding: Early gestational diabetes mellitus screening in a high-risk population did not show a benefit in reducing cesarean delivery, preeclampsia, LGA, SGA, or macrosomia, and it was associated with a higher incidence of preterm birth.
mod_finding: Early and routine screening groups for gestational diabetes had similar incidences of cesarean delivery.
